GrandmasterShen_P1_AbbotSweep.notes: Abbot's Sweep: the weight sinks into the hip, then a wide low wheel at shin height with a committed follow-through; jump it.

GrandmasterShen_P1_Death.notes: Killed: staggers, sinks to the right knee on the haft, lets go: the glaive clatters flat beside him and he falls forward onto his chest, left hand out; a small rebound and he lies still before the fade.

GrandmasterShen_P1_DeathblowVictim.notes: Takes the deathblow on the knee: head snaps back, then the old body bows over the haft.

GrandmasterShen_P1_Feint.notes: A cut that never comes: the whole body commits, the blade stops short at the top and he settles back. No warning is shown, because nothing is thrown.

GrandmasterShen_P1_Flourish.notes: Three unhurried pinwheels of the glaive, caught back into both hands; plays between exchanges so the pause is never the same twice.

GrandmasterShen_P1_FlowingJian.notes: Flowing Glaive: four linked curved cuts on the server's deflect pulses: a falling diagonal, its mirror on the way back, a rising cut, and an overhead finish, each flowing out of the last in a figure eight. Stable id FlowingJian.

GrandmasterShen_P1_Guandao_Art.notes: Crescent Moon Cyclone: he winds left, then the whole body pivots right on the balls of the feet with the blade at the end of both arms; the server's 360 degree blow.

GrandmasterShen_P1_Guandao_Heavy.notes: Green Dragon Reaping: winds until his back shows, then hips, chest and arms unwind in that order, and the blade carries his weight past the target.

GrandmasterShen_P1_Guandao_L1.notes: Crescent Reap: left shoulder to right hip, hips driving first, the rear foot pivoting behind them.

GrandmasterShen_P1_Guandao_L2.notes: Returning Tide: the blade drops to his left hip and climbs through to the right shoulder off the rear foot's step.

GrandmasterShen_P1_Guandao_L3.notes: Heaven-Splitting Cleave: up over the head and straight down the server's line, a long step under it.

GrandmasterShen_P1_Guandao_Running.notes: Charging Crescent: out of the run the blade rises from his left hip across the server's lunge, and the run carries into the step.

GrandmasterShen_P1_GuardHit.notes: A blow on the haft: he gives a little ground and resets.

GrandmasterShen_P1_GuardLoop.notes: Haft raised across the body in both hands, weight low and quiet.

GrandmasterShen_P1_HesitantMoon.notes: Hesitant Moon: the blade rises and hangs at the top of the cut longer than it should, so a deflect pressed at the expected moment is too early; then it falls from his right shoulder across his body.

GrandmasterShen_P1_HitLightBack.notes: Flinch from the blow's direction: chest first, then the hips and the rear foot give; the cloth takes the same push at run time.

GrandmasterShen_P1_HitLightFront.notes: Flinch from the blow's direction: chest first, then the hips and the rear foot give; the cloth takes the same push at run time.

GrandmasterShen_P1_HitLightLeft.notes: Flinch from the blow's direction: chest first, then the hips and the rear foot give; the cloth takes the same push at run time.

GrandmasterShen_P1_HitLightRight.notes: Flinch from the blow's direction: chest first, then the hips and the rear foot give; the cloth takes the same push at run time.

GrandmasterShen_P1_Idle.notes: The guard alive: both hands on the glaive, slow breath, weight drifting between the feet.

GrandmasterShen_P1_PostureBreak.notes: Stance broken: thrown back, the levitation fails if he had it, and he sinks to his right knee on the haft, still holding it in both hands.

GrandmasterShen_P1_PrayerBeads.notes: The glaive pinwheels and gathers seven beads off his breath, the left hand catches it and the falling cut flings them on the server's release.

GrandmasterShen_P1_RunForward.notes: RunForward: 6.11 rig studs per second at speed 1.

GrandmasterShen_P1_StrafeLeft.notes: StrafeLeft: 1.54 rig studs per second at speed 1.

GrandmasterShen_P1_StrafeRight.notes: StrafeRight: 1.54 rig studs per second at speed 1.

GrandmasterShen_P1_Strike.notes: Fallback diagonal cut for any move without its own slot.

GrandmasterShen_P1_Transform.notes: He falters and bows over the glaive, both hands tight on it; reaches the shared handoff pose at the Reveal and holds it for the swap.

GrandmasterShen_P1_TurnLeft.notes: TurnLeft at 220 degrees per second, speed 1.

GrandmasterShen_P1_TurnRight.notes: TurnRight at 220 degrees per second, speed 1.

GrandmasterShen_P1_WalkBackward.notes: WalkBackward: 1.48 rig studs per second at speed 1.

GrandmasterShen_P1_WalkForward.notes: WalkForward: 1.98 rig studs per second at speed 1.

GrandmasterShen_P1_WheelOfHeaven.notes: Wheel of Heaven: two full pinwheels of the glaive beside him, then the left hand catches it and two cuts come close together, a falling diagonal and a rising return.

GrandmasterShen_P2_BloodWave.notes: The glaive's edge drags from his left, the whole body hauling it, then whips up and casts the low wave on the server's start.

GrandmasterShen_P2_CrimsonEmbrace.notes: The one move where a hand leaves the haft: the clawed left arm reaches with the whole torso behind it while the glaive swings back in the right. Cosmetic only: nothing attaches to a player.

GrandmasterShen_P2_GuandaoSkyfall.notes: Coils, the server's aerial path carries the root, glaive high at the apex, and the blade falls with him; his feet touch down and his knees absorb the landing at the impact, then he lifts again.

GrandmasterShen_P2_HitLightRight.notes: Flinch from the blow's direction: chest first, then the hips and the rear foot give; the cloth takes the same push at run time.

GrandmasterShen_P2_Idle.notes: He hangs in the air and cannot hold still: panting, head hunting in short snaps, the glaive drifting.

GrandmasterShen_P2_PhantomDrift.notes: Phantom Drift: he leans back and hangs in the air, then glides through the server's lunge with his legs trailing and the blade falling across him.

GrandmasterShen_P2_PostureBreak.notes: Stance broken: thrown back, the levitation fails if he had it, and he sinks to his right knee on the haft, still holding it in both hands.

GrandmasterShen_P2_RendingArc.notes: Rending Arc: three cuts in a broken rhythm, the third held back so the third deflect has to wait for it.

GrandmasterShen_P2_RunForward.notes: RunForward: floating; 7.48 rig studs per second at speed 1.

GrandmasterShen_P2_StrafeLeft.notes: StrafeLeft: floating; 1.95 rig studs per second at speed 1.

GrandmasterShen_P2_StrafeRight.notes: StrafeRight: floating; 1.95 rig studs per second at speed 1.

GrandmasterShen_P2_Strike.notes: Fallback diagonal cut for any move without its own slot.

GrandmasterShen_P2_Transform.notes: Revealed from the shared handoff pose in the burst: he straightens, the glaive thrown wide in both hands, and on the roar his feet leave the floor. Ends exactly on the phase 2 idle.

GrandmasterShen_P2_TurnLeft.notes: Floating, he simply rotates; the upper body leads the turn.

GrandmasterShen_P2_TurnRight.notes: Floating, he simply rotates; the upper body leads the turn.

GrandmasterShen_P2_WalkBackward.notes: WalkBackward: floating; 1.80 rig studs per second at speed 1.

GrandmasterShen_P2_WalkForward.notes: WalkForward: floating; 2.40 rig studs per second at speed 1.
